# 3 bed detached house for sale

> This property offers a charming setting, being within less than 10 minute drive to Waterville village, beach and the world famous Golf Course. The road outside the property is a quiet residential road, The property is a storey and half stone build house with various outbuildings set upon Circa 0.379 of an acre.
